title: Club Meeting - 5th November 2026
summary: RCMSEP conducted its first club meeting for November on Thursday, 5th November 2026, at Indriya Mishran, Andheri East.
description: RCMSEP conducted its first club meeting for November on Thursday, 5th November 2026, at Indriya Mishran, Andheri East. The President and the club members reviewed the projects and service initiatives completed since the previous meeting and discussed upcoming projects and planned activities for the month. The meeting provided an opportunity to review the club’s progress, plan future initiatives and strengthen collective commitment towards Rotary’s motto of Service Above Self. The meeting was attended by 13 members.
